heading.zh-Hant: 出身、加里波利與皇家飛行軍團
heading.en: Origins, Gallipoli and the Royal Flying Corps

body.zh-Hant: 凱斯·帕克1892年6月15日生於紐西蘭泰晤士。1915年他在加里波利的榴彈砲連服役，同年7月獲任少尉；其後轉赴索姆河前線，1916年10月負傷送回英國，被判定只能在本土服役。同年12月他轉入皇家飛行軍團，自1918年4月起任第48中隊指揮官，直到停戰。
body.en: Keith Park was born at Thames, New Zealand, on 15 June 1892. In 1915 he served with a howitzer battery at Gallipoli, where he was commissioned second lieutenant in July. He later went to the Somme front; wounded in October 1916 and declared fit for home service only, he transferred to the Royal Flying Corps in December 1916, and from April 1918 until the armistice he commanded No 48 Squadron.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰鬥機司令部、敦克爾克與不列顛戰役
heading.en: Fighter Command, Dunkirk and the Battle of Britain

body.zh-Hant: 1938年7月，帕克晉升空軍准將，出任戰鬥機司令部道丁的副手（高級空軍參謀官）；1940年4月他受命指揮倫敦周邊的第11戰鬥機大隊。敦克爾克撤退期間他可調用十六個颶風與噴火式中隊，並親自駕颶風機飛越敦克爾克數次。不列顛戰役中他力求在敵機抵達目標前攔截，此一戰法與主張先集結大編隊的第12大隊利－馬洛里引發爭議；他於12月18日由利－馬洛里接替。
body.en: In July 1938 Park was promoted to air commodore and became Dowding’s deputy (Senior Air Staff Officer) at HQ Fighter Command, and in April 1940 he was given command of No. 11 Fighter Group around London. During the Dunkirk evacuation he had sixteen Hurricane and Spitfire squadrons and personally flew his Hurricane over Dunkirk several times. In the Battle of Britain he sought to intercept raids before they reached their targets, which drew controversy with Leigh-Mallory of No. 12 Group, who preferred to assemble large formations of fighters; Leigh-Mallory replaced him on 18 December.

heading.zh-Hant: 第23訓練大隊、埃及與馬爾他接任
heading.en: No. 23 Group, Egypt and the move to Malta

body.zh-Hant: 1941年帕克主持格洛斯特郡的第23訓練大隊。其後他出任埃及空軍司令部指揮官（1942年），花六個月建立埃及的防空體系；1942年7月改任馬爾他空軍司令，接替洛伊德。他一到任便改變戰鬥機戰術，令戰機在接敵途中爬升，盡量在島北遠處攔截。
body.en: In 1941 Park headed No. 23 (Training) Group in Gloucestershire. He then became AOC in Egypt (1942), spending six months organising its air defence, and in July 1942 became AOC Malta, replacing AVM H P Lloyd. He soon changed fighter tactics so that fighters gained height while approaching the enemy and intercepted as far north of the island as possible.

heading.zh-Hant: 佩德斯托行動與馬爾他攻勢
heading.en: Operation Pedestal and the Malta offensive

body.zh-Hant: 1942年8月，帕克參與護衛「基座行動」船團：他的噴火式與美男子式戰機掩護船團，十四艘商船中僅五艘抵達馬爾他。突尼西亞戰役後期，他的馬爾他皇家空軍成為地中海空軍司令部轄下三大單位之一；西西里登陸前，馬爾他、戈佐與潘泰萊里亞集結了四十個戰鬥機中隊。1944年1月，他晉升空軍中將，出任駐開羅的中東空軍總司令。
body.en: In August 1942 Park took part in the defence of Operation Pedestal; his Spitfires and Beaufighters covered the convoy, and only five of its fourteen merchant ships reached Malta. In the later Tunisian campaign his RAF Malta was one of the three formations under Mediterranean Air Command, and before the invasion of Sicily forty fighter squadrons waited on Malta, Gozo and Pantelleria. In January 1944 he was promoted to air marshal and became Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief, Middle East, in Cairo.

heading.zh-Hant: 東南亞空軍總司令與退役
heading.en: Air Command South East Asia and retirement

body.zh-Hant: 1944年11月26日皮爾斯卸下東南亞空軍指揮權；原定接任的利－馬洛里赴任途中死於空難，由加羅德代理，直到帕克於1945年2月23日抵達。新任盟軍空軍總司令帕克當天同意，每日為緬甸地面部隊空運1887噸，5月增至2075噸。他於1946年12月退役，軍階為空軍上將。
body.en: On 26 November 1944 Peirse relinquished Air Command South East Asia; Leigh-Mallory, chosen to succeed him, was killed in an air crash on his way out, and Garrod held the command until Park arrived on 23 February 1945. That day the new Allied Air Commander-in-Chief agreed to a planned airlift for the armies in Burma of 1,887 tons a day, rising to 2,075 tons a day in May. He retired as an Air Chief Marshal in December 1946.

body.en.before: According to the Air of Authority (rafweb) page, Keith Park was born on 15 June 1892 in New Zealand. body.en.after: Keith Park was born at Thames, New Zealand, on 15 June 1892. In 1915 he served with a howitzer battery at Gallipoli, where he was commissioned second lieutenant in July. He later went to the Somme front; wounded in October 1916 and declared fit for home service only, he transferred to the Royal Flying Corps in December 1916, and from April 1918 until the armistice he commanded No 48 Squadron.

body.en.before: On 11 June 1938 Park became Senior Air Staff Officer at HQ Fighter Command, and in April 1940 he was given command of No. 11 Fighter Group around London. body.en.after: In July 1938 Park was promoted to air commodore and became Dowding’s deputy (Senior Air Staff Officer) at HQ Fighter Command, and in April 1940 he was given command of No. 11 Fighter Group around London. During the Dunkirk evacuation he had sixteen Hurricane and Spitfire squadrons and personally flew his Hurricane over Dunkirk several times. In the Battle of Britain he sought to intercept raids before they reached their targets, which drew controversy with Leigh-Mallory of No. 12 Group, who preferred to assemble large formations of fighters; Leigh-Mallory replaced him on 18 December.

body.en.before: In November 1944 Leigh-Mallory was killed on his way to Air Command South East Asia and Park was chosen to replace him. Rafweb records him as Allied Air C in C, Air Command South East Asia from 25 February 1945; his task was to fly up to 2,000 tons of supplies a day to the advancing armies in Burma and to give aggressive fighter-bomber cover. body.en.after: On 26 November 1944 Peirse relinquished Air Command South East Asia; Leigh-Mallory, chosen to succeed him, was killed in an air crash on his way out, and Garrod held the command until Park arrived on 23 February 1945. That day the new Allied Air Commander-in-Chief agreed to a planned airlift for the armies in Burma of 1,887 tons a day, rising to 2,075 tons a day in May. He retired as an Air Chief Marshal in December 1946.

heading.en: Origins and early service

body.zh-Hant: 據 Air of Authority（rafweb）頁面，羅德里克·卡爾生於1891年8月31日。他就讀於紐西蘭威靈頓學院，先加入紐西蘭遠征軍，再轉入皇家海軍航空隊；1918年6月22日起任第91中隊指揮官。
body.en: According to the Air of Authority (rafweb) page, Roderick Carr was born on 31 August 1891. He was educated at Wellington College in New Zealand and joined the New Zealand Expeditionary Force before transferring to the RNAS; from 22 June 1918 he commanded No 91 Squadron.

before.zh-Hant: 1919年3月17日，卡爾出任北俄羅斯遠征軍中斯拉夫－英國航空軍團第2中隊指揮官。據 DFC 嘉獎令，他駕偵察機低空飛越敵方普切加機場，擊燃一架尼厄波特敵機與一座機庫。1927年5月20至23日，他與吉爾曼駕霍克霍斯利機自克蘭威爾不著陸飛抵波斯灣，創下3420英里新紀錄。

heading.en: Origins and early wars

body.zh-Hant: 據 Greek City Times 的文章，亞歷山大·帕普哥斯生於1883年12月9日，生於雅典，家族根源在小亞細亞的艾瓦利。自1906年起他在希臘軍中服役45年，參加過巴爾幹戰爭（1912至1913年）與小亞細亞戰役（1919至1922年）。
body.en: Per a Greek City Times article, Alexandros Papagos was born on 9 December 1883 in Athens, with roots in Aivali, Asia Minor. From 1906 he served 45 years in the Greek military, taking part in the Balkan Wars (1912-13) and the Asia Minor Campaign (1919-22).

Born in Athens but with roots in Aivali, Asia Minor
Starting from 1906, Papagos served 45 years in the Greek Military
serving in the Balkan Wars (1912-13), the Asia Minor Campaign (1919-22)

heading.zh-Hant: 陸軍部長與陸軍總參謀長
heading.en: War minister and Army General Staff chief

body.zh-Hant: 據 protothema 與 Orthodoxia 的文章，帕普哥斯曾任軍事（陸軍）部長，列於孔迪利斯內閣（1935年10月10日至11月30日）與代梅爾齊斯內閣（1935年12月19日至1936年3月5日）。1936年8月1日他接任陸軍總參謀部（ΓΕΣ）參謀長，並與梅塔克薩斯從頭整編陸軍、擬定完整的動員計畫。
body.en: According to protothema and Orthodoxia articles, Papagos was Minister for Military Affairs in the Kondylis government (10 October–30 November 1935) and the Demertzis government (19 December 1935–5 March 1936). On 1 August 1936 he took over as chief of the Army General Staff (GES) and, with Metaxas, rebuilt the army from the ground up and prepared a complete mobilisation plan.

heading.zh-Hant: 希意戰爭與1941年希臘戰役
heading.en: The Greco-Italian War and the Battle of Greece

body.zh-Hant: 希意戰爭爆發的1940年10月28日，帕普哥斯已是總司令；他指揮阿爾巴尼亞戰線的希臘軍事行動，希軍在他的指揮下遏止義軍攻勢並把對方逼回阿爾巴尼亞北部。1941年德軍南下時，英國官方戰史稱他為盟軍總司令：4月9日他中止阿爾巴尼亞戰線上對義軍的攻勢，10日下令英軍W部隊撤退，16日同意撤至色摩比利防線，並向英方提議全數撤出希臘；據 protothema，他於4月23日請辭，不願參與投降程序。
body.en: On 28 October 1940, when the Greco-Italian War began, Papagos was already Commander-in-Chief; he directed Greek operations on the Albanian front, and under his command the Greek army halted the Italian advance and pushed it back into northern Albania. In the 1941 German campaign the British official history calls him Allied Commander-in-Chief: he broke off the attack on the Italians on 9 April, ordered W Force to withdraw on 10 April, approved the retirement to Thermopylae on 16 April and suggested the British withdraw from Greece altogether; according to protothema he resigned on 23 April rather than take part in the capitulation.

heading.en: Occupation, civil war and politics

body.zh-Hant: 希臘遭德軍佔領後，帕普哥斯組織由希臘軍官組成的抵抗團體；1943年他被德軍逮捕並押往達豪集中營，直到1945年解放。1949年1月10日他接受總司令職務，領導對共產黨游擊隊的最後勝利；1951年5月30日他提出辭呈，其後創立希臘聯盟黨，1952年11月選舉獲勝，擔任首相直至1955年10月4日去世。
body.en: After the German occupation Papagos organised a resistance movement of Greek officers; in 1943 he was arrested by the Germans and sent to Dachau, where he remained until liberation in 1945. He accepted the post of Commander-in-Chief on 10 January 1949 to lead the final victory over the communist guerrillas; on 30 May 1951 he submitted his resignation, then founded the Greek Rally, won the November 1952 elections, and served as Prime Minister until his death on 4 October 1955.
